about.metaDescription: Professional background, technical skills and education in geomatics. CV available for download in French and English.
about.heading: About
about.bio1: I work at the intersection of geomatics and technical drafting. My job is to turn heterogeneous territorial data — surveys, imagery, municipal databases, CAD drawings — into reliable, usable cartographic products.
about.bio2: What sets me apart: I am equally fluent in the GIS chain (spatial analysis, geoprocessing, Python automation) and the CAD chain (engineering plans, surveying, Civil 3D), and I know how to make the two talk to each other. That dual competency is rare and valuable on infrastructure and planning projects.
about.bio3: Based in Quebec, I work in both French and English, with particular interest in municipal mandates, consulting engineering and territorial resource management.
